children: ), a global AI-centered technology research and advisory firm, today introduced ISG OneSource™, a groundbreaking AI-enabled provider intelligence platform built specifically for software and technology providers, drawing on ISG’s deep knowledge of how providers compete, how buyers evaluate them and how provider teams use market insight in their daily work.

in Dallas, the premier annual event for software, service and technology providers, ISG OneSource offers access to the firm’s trusted market insights, proprietary ISG research and AI-enabled intelligence in one connected experience to inform providers’ business strategies, positioning and pursuits. The platform will be available to ISG Research subscribers in the coming weeks.

ISG OneSource is powered by the AI-enabled AskISG capability, which allows users to ask questions in natural language and use preconfigured prompts custom-designed for provider workflows to organize and apply relevant findings.

ISG OneSource gives users access to nearly 9,000 research documents from ISG Provider Lens® and ISG Software Research, enriched by real-world insight from the thousands of client engagements led by ISG advisors and analysts. Together, they provide an evidence-based view of markets, providers and buyer priorities. Approximately 25 new reports are added each week.

“ISG OneSource puts the full power of our research, AI-enabled intelligence and expert perspective to work in one connected experience,” said John Boccuzzi, Jr., president, ISG Research. “ISG has the industry’s broadest and deepest portfolio of authoritative software and services market reports, informed by our work with enterprise clients. This combination of proprietary research, advisor-informed market perspective and provider-specific workflows helps users apply trusted insights directly into their workflow to make growth decisions with greater confidence.”

ISG’s software and services research, covering 4,700 providers, helps provider teams understand markets, buyer priorities and competitors, sharpen their positioning, prepare for briefings and pursuits and support go-to-market activities. AskISG makes ISG research easier to apply in daily workflows, helping subscribers move from reading individual reports to answering specific business questions.

Preconfigured prompts, built around ISG’s deep understanding of provider workflows, reflect the recurring decisions provider teams face, including where to compete, how to differentiate and how to strengthen a pursuit. The prompts organize and apply relevant research across provider strategy, marketing, sales, analyst and advisor relations, competitive intelligence, product planning and growth initiatives. The result is consistent, relevant guidance grounded in ISG research, with detailed attribution to the source material behind each insight.

Subscribers can move seamlessly from AI-enabled insights to deeper conversations with ISG experts, scheduling analyst meetings within ISG OneSource for additional interpretation, validation or context.

As the founder and leader of the sourcing industry, ISG influences more than $200 billion in annual sourcing spend, working with leading enterprises to support the entire sourcing lifecycle. ISG advisors use ISG OneSource to support enterprise provider selection by evaluating which providers have the capabilities the client needs and comparing provider strengths and differentiation.

“Our market-leading research library and our expert advisors have long been a source of critical insights on what enterprise buyers prioritize, how they evaluate alternatives and how providers compare,” Paul Reynolds, partner and chief research officer, ISG, said today in his launch presentation at the Sourcing Industry Conference. “ISG OneSource gives provider teams the tools to turn that information into a confident position when decisions are being made.”
Future ISG OneSource releases will include additional ISG research and data sources. For more information about ISG OneSource, visit this webpage.

ISG (Nasdaq: III) is a global AI-centered technology research and advisory firm. A trusted partner to more than 900 clients, including 75 of the world’s top 100 enterprises, ISG is a long-time leader in technology and business services that is now at the forefront of leveraging AI to help organizations achieve operational excellence and faster growth. The firm, founded in 2006, is known for its proprietary market data and research, in-depth knowledge and governance of provider ecosystems, and the expertise of its 1,500 professionals worldwide working together to help clients maximize the value of their technology investments.
